page.notes: Page number "128" is read from a small, heavily worn numeral; the first digit is doubtful. "ditimus" (line 20) is unclear and may be a misprint for "divinius" or similar; left as the best reading. "profligandae" (line 18) is partly obscured; the first letters are read as "pro" with the rest from context. The long-s forms (s) have been normalised to plain s as instructed. Faint specks in the left margin are not printed text and are not transcribed.
